28.comment: Kinlaw (shoulder) did not practice Wednesday, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

28.name: Nick Cross
28.comment: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Cross (internal injury) won't play in Sunday's game versus the Seahawks, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

28.name: Jayden Daniels
28.comment: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn confirmed that Daniels will be out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks, but the quarterback remains without a precise timeline for a return while he continues to receive more medical opinions on his left elbow injury, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

28.name: Jaylin Lane
28.comment: Lane returned six kickoffs for 120 yards and one punt for 14 yards in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Colson Yankoff
28.comment: Yankoff caught his only target for 14 yards in Sunday's Week 2 loss to Dallas.

28.name: Treylon Burks
28.comment: Burks failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: John Bates
28.comment: Bates played 22 offensive snaps and 14 special-teams snaps in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Sonny Styles
28.comment: Styles recorded three total tackles during Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Ben Sinnott
28.comment: Sinnott caught his only target for six yards in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Dyami Brown
28.comment: Brown caught four of his six targets for 21 yards and completed his sole pass attempt for zero yards while losing one fumble in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Antonio Williams
28.comment: Williams caught all three of his targets for 24 yards and failed to complete his only pass attempt in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Sam Cosmi
28.comment: Cosmi suffered a concussion in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

28.name: Drew Stevens
28.comment: Stevens made two of his three field-goal attempts while converting both PATs in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Cowboys.

28.name: Marcus Mariota
28.comment: Mariota is expected to start Sunday's game against Seattle while the Commanders continue to gather more information on the severity of Jayden Daniels' dislocated left elbow, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
